description: Returns the k-th largest value in a data set. For example, the fifth largest number.

params.description: The array or range of data for which the k-th largest value will be determined.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The position (from the largest) in the array or cell range of data to return.
params.name: arg2

signature: LARGE(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number[], arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
